question: A 50-year-old man with no prior psychiatric history presents with a 2-week history of prominent visual hallucinations, disorientation, and fluctuating consciousness following cardiac surgery. Using the classificatory axes taught in this SDL, which is the most appropriate initial clinical reasoning step?

answers.text: Classify as a neurotic disorder and initiate anxiolytic therapy for post-operative distress.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Visual hallucinations, disorientation, and fluctuating consciousness in a post-operative patient are not features of neurotic disorder. The clinical picture strongly suggests an organic cause.

answers.text: Classify as a functional psychotic disorder (e.g., brief psychotic disorder) and initiate antipsychotics while awaiting psychiatric review.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Functional psychosis is a diagnosis of exclusion. New-onset psychosis post-operatively in a middle-aged man with no psychiatric history must be presumed organic until proved otherwise.

answers.text: Apply the organic-versus-functional axis first: investigate and treat a possible organic (medical) cause such as post-operative delirium before attributing to primary psychiatric illness.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. The organic-functional axis is the first discriminating step. Post-operative visual hallucinations, disorientation, and fluctuating consciousness constitute a classic delirium presentation. Organic aetiology must be sought and treated before any primary psychiatric diagnosis is made.

answers.text: Classify as ICD-11 schizophrenia spectrum disorder and refer to a psychiatrist for long-term management.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Schizophrenia spectrum disorders require characteristic symptoms persisting over time and exclude organic aetiology. Immediate organic work-up is mandated first.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the Clinical Significance section. The organic-functional axis must be applied before any functional psychiatric diagnosis is entertained, especially in new-onset presentation in medical-surgical contexts.
Excellent application. Post-operative psychosis always triggers the organic-functional axis first. Delirium is the most common psychiatric presentation in surgical wards.
